checkpoint: PF3 evidence correction / PF4A action-accounting reconciliation

immutableOriginal.policy: The original accepted artifact and its recorded measurements are not rewritten. This amendment corrects only the interpretation and future evidence schema.

retainedMismatchSoak.legacyCrossCounterCaveat: Legacy per-action attempts were recorded after TryObserve accepted an input sample, including a held button which generated no new rising edge. Scheduler edge totals count rising-edge obligations across action kinds. Their observation boundaries differ; summing legacy terminal outcomes produces 55,303 while the scheduler reports 55,302 edges and is not a valid conservation equality.

disposition.explanation: TryObserve can validly accept a repeated held input while generating no new action edge. The old attempt counters incremented at that earlier observation boundary, whereas Accepted/Rejected existed only for an actual submitted Game command. The 2,599 Jump remainder therefore represents no-new-edge observations, not vanished transport or authority work.
disposition.momentaryInputCorrection: PF3 development also retained one matching Release obligation behind each bot Jump/Interaction/Primary press. PF4A preserves that behavior and makes any remaining held/no-edge observation explicit rather than silently subtracting it.

models.LatestStateToSubmission: Movement may be coalesced before submission and does not require an individual authority completion for every source value.
models.EdgeToAuthorityCompletion: Jump, Interaction, Primary and UiOpen retain one finite rising-edge obligation through the authoritative processed-sequence result.
models.SchedulerCompletion: ReleaseOrStop is conserved through scheduler completion rather than a separate Game action result.

pf4aSchemaVersion6.finalBoundary: pendingUnsent = 0; pendingCompletion = 0; unexplained = 0; conserved = true; terminal = true
pf4aSchemaVersion6.acceptanceBehavior: The PF4A summary writer, long-run shell gate, focused repository verifier, and permanent bot tests reject any unexplained or terminal-debt row.

histogramTerminology.rolling: Unprefixed P50/P95/P99 values are exact percentiles over the most recent bounded 256 observations; Maximum is the exact whole-window maximum.
histogramTerminology.wholeWindow: WholeWindow P50/P95/P99 values are conservative power-of-two histogram bucket upper bounds, not exact observations.
histogramTerminology.evidenceRule: Permanent prose and new artifacts identify whole-window values as BucketUpperBoundMicroseconds and do not describe 8,191/16,383/32,767 microseconds as exact medians or tails.

regression.heldJump: A repeated held Jump can be observed successfully while creating no new edge and is counted as NotAdmittedNoNewEdge.
regression.allActions: Each action model has focused source-to-terminal conservation coverage.
regression.cleanRetirement: PF4A real-client summaries require zero pending and zero unexplained work after quiescence and retirement.
